premises.text: Companies share data with far more vendors than they realize and lack an easy way to track sharing or meet privacy obligations
premises.evidence_span: there is no easy way to track what's happening with all of that data, and there's no easy way for companies to comply with their privacy obligations

premises.text: A proprietary vendor privacy dataset scores vendors' practices, lawsuits, and policies for risk decisions
premises.evidence_span: Utilizing our proprietary data set of 7,000 different vendors, Osano provides a 360-degree view of each vendor's privacy practices

premises.text: A fully managed cookie-consent solution makes websites compliant across many countries with one line of code
premises.evidence_span: Osano includes a fully managed cookie consent solution, so that with one line of code, websites can immediately become compliant with the laws of 40 different countries

premises.text: A developer API lets builders embed data privacy into applications and workflows
premises.evidence_span: Asono offers a developer API so that developers can quickly build data privacy into their applications and their workflows

premises.text: Go-to-market targets the majority of companies underserved by expensive point solutions, converting freemium compliance users
premises.evidence_span: Osana was targeting the 90 percent of companies who are not served by the expensive point solutions

value.text: Easy data-privacy compliance and vendor-risk visibility for companies
